title: Strict cochain model of the resolved sequence-site mapping tower before limits
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l and X a scheme. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaf and constant-ring sequence-site mapping functors of [def-coef-integral-dualizing-mapping-towers], and signed global Hom with the compatible-section scalar action of [lem-coef-integral-dualizing-resolved-global-hom]. Let I be any K-injective complex of strict towers of completed coefficient module sheaves. The sequence-site derived internal Hom from the constant localization of a source complex P into QI, followed by the sequence-site total derived sections, is naturally isomorphic in the derived category of strict integral module towers to the localization of the transposed strict tower n ↦ Γ_R Hom(P,I_n). Its differentials are the signed Hom differentials and transitions are postcomposition; naturality is in every source complex. No injectivity of the terms of I and no comparison involving an inverse limit is asserted.

source.place: Tags 0A95, 0A96, 08JA; Tag 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok), sequence-site representative calculation before taking inverse limit.

proof.text: The additive exact constant-ring sequence equivalence sends the K-injective tower I to a K-injective sequence-site complex. Exact constant sources commute with localization. The replacement-normalized internal-Hom comparison computes the derived Hom by the Hom complex into that K-injective.

For a flat-term K-flat source, Hom into the K-injective target is K-injective. Hence ordinary sequence sections compute derived sections. The slice restriction and reconstruction formulas identify the result with the strict signed Hom tower. They preserve the scalar action and are natural under precomposition.

For any source take a K-flat resolution. K-injectivity of the tower and its evaluations makes precomposition a quasi-isomorphism on sheaf Hom and on all global Hom complexes. The naturality square for the derived-sections unit transfers invertibility to the arbitrary source. The canonical comparisons assemble to a natural isomorphism; no degreewise injectivity or limit comparison is asserted.

theorem integralDualizing_resolved_mappingTower
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.op ⋙
      (coefHomDerivedConstant l E X).op ⋙
      (Functor.curry.obj (coefHomConstantInternalHom l E X)).flip.obj
        ((coefHomEquivalence l E X).inverse.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ⋙ coefHomConstantDerivedSections l E X ≅
      integralDualizingResolvedMappingCochains l E X I ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
